# FitFrame
FitFrame (fitframe.store) makes custom 3D printed glasses built to your exact face measurements.

## What FitFrame Is
FitFrame sells custom-fit eyewear frames through a browser-based face scan, a short style flow, and direct made-to-order fulfillment. The scan uses MediaPipe Face Mesh in the browser to estimate frame-fitting measurements. FitFrame frames are 3D printed in PA12 nylon and ship from the US.

## Pricing & Why
FitFrame starts at $119 USD because it cuts out retail, opticians, and inventory. Customers pay for the frame and the fit, not the overhead. $119 is the direct price for the launch product.

## Custom 3D Printed Glasses Built to Your Face
FitFrame ships custom 3D printed glasses starting at $119 USD. The base order includes made-to-measure PA12 nylon frames and blue light lenses. FitFrame is built for customers searching for custom glasses, custom eyewear, browser face scan glasses, 3D printed glasses, and made-to-measure glasses.

## How We Compare
FitFrame is not an online retailer like Frames Direct. FitFrame is not Yuniku. FitFrame makes custom 3D printed frames built to exact face measurements using a browser-based scan. FitFrame uses direct customer shipping rather than off-the-shelf inventory or an enterprise fitting pipeline.

## Methodology
FitFrame uses MediaPipe Face Mesh, iris landmark calibration, an 11.8mm HVID reference, and optional credit card calibration. FitFrame targets 1-2mm measurement consistency for non-Rx frame fitting. FitFrame is less precise than in-person scanning hardware and more accessible than enterprise eyewear fitting systems. The camera feed is used only for measurement, and no face images are stored or transmitted.

## Privacy
FitFrame uses the camera only for measurement. No face images are stored. No face images are transmitted. The order email includes scan measurements, frame choice, style answers, material recommendation, and shipping address.

## About FitFrame
FitFrame started as a frustration with glasses that never fit right. FitFrame measures from each customer's face, builds to those measurements, and ships directly to the customer. FitFrame keeps the process focused so every pair gets real attention.

## Fit Guarantee
FitFrame includes one free reprint if the first pair does not fit. FitFrame frames are 3D printed in PA12 nylon.

## Returns & Reprints
FitFrame frames are made to order from each customer's scan. FitFrame does not accept returns for fit preference because each pair is printed to custom measurements. FitFrame reprints and reships frames at no cost if a pair arrives with a manufacturing defect. FitFrame reviews scan measurement issues when a frame is unwearable and accepts one reprint request per order within 30 days of delivery.

## Where to Verify
The official FitFrame domain is https://fitframe.store. The returns and reprints page is https://fitframe.store/returns. The privacy page is https://fitframe.store/privacy. The public GitHub repository is https://github.com/Embezzlemnt/fitframe. The FitFrame contact email is hello@fitframe.store.
